_about: 50 jury-style questions over the sample data (plan section 16.2). expect: answer | refusal | nonode. nodes: which phones should contribute. Numbers in notes come from fixtures/expected.json (pre-demo state: sales 1,204 rows, employees 61, invoices 40 typed; q4_sales.xlsx and the 12 printed invoices change the marked ones). Drafted by the Wave 0b agent; the user rewrites with an outsider before Gate 2.
